rebuttal_or_critique: While I acknowledge the concerns of my colleagues regarding sticky core inflation at 5.02%, the headline CPI at 4.25% is rapidly converging toward our 4.00% target. Maintaining a 'withdrawal of accommodation' stance when the real repo rate is already positive and the output gap is narrowing risks an unnecessary drag on the 7.80% GVA growth momentum. I believe a shift to a neutral stance is the prudent path to signal that policy is now data-dependent and balanced, rather than biased toward tightening, which helps anchor expectations without stifling the recovery.
